Children attend school amid dilapidated conditions and waterlogged roads

Reports highlight students in Madhya Pradesh attending school under hazardous conditions. In Betul, a government middle school's dilapidated roof leaks water, forcing children to study amidst risks during rain. Separately, a road leading to a school became a muddy swamp after the first rain, making it difficult for young children to reach school.
